name: PERSUADE 2.0
summary: Over 25,000 argumentative essays by U.S. students in grades 6 to 12, with holistic scores and annotated argument elements rated for effectiveness.

license.note: CC BY 4.0 since 2026-10-27; earlier copies say CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. The data includes writers' demographics.

access_note: CSV files linked from the README; the test set's archive password is in the README.
cite: Crossley, S. A., Tian, Y., Baffour, P., Franklin, A., Benner, M., & Boser, U. (2024). A large-scale corpus for assessing written argumentation: PERSUADE 2.0. Assessing Writing, 61, 100865. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.asw.2024.100865

fits.how: No slot yet: its essays could be the learner's work in agent test cases for a writing feedback agent.

connect.note: Its files are behind Google Drive links with no stable address to pin. ASAP 2.0 holds about half of its essays with the same kind of score, and is connected.
